name: React Site Bridge
description: Tenant-scoped content manifests, media mappings, visual route-content editing, and a compact cross-device live-canvas editor. Adds a reliable layered Show controls recovery path plus a responsive Edit History & Revisions panel with synchronized session actions, preview, rollback, baseline and published-revision loading, and dock or overlay presentation. Includes a unified single-row header, responsive inspector, compact action row, concise small-screen route navigation, all-device inspector hide/show, Edit and Scroll modes, local undo and redo, selected-element reset, searchable approved media, comparison-based publish review, text, links, images, background images, reversible transparent text-background removal, dark-overlay contrast, focal-point crop previews, Slate Media upload-and-map workflow, guided imports, direct Slate-hosted React releases, recoverable site management, and Slate-domain preview links.
author: Slate

permissions.label: Manage React sites, documents, media mappings, and previews
